title: Machine-learning aortic calcification score on bone density scans predicts vascular events
summary: The previously developed ML-AAC24 algorithm scored abdominal aortic calcification on lateral spine DXA images from 53,611 UK Biobank Imaging participants. Of 50,923 without prevalent disease, 1,163 (2.3%) had an incident ASCVD event over a median 4.1 years; the hazard ratio was 1.80 (95% CI 1.57-2.08) for moderate and 2.87 (95% CI 2.39-3.44) for high scores compared with low, and results persisted after adjustment for risk factors. Follow-up is short and the association is not causal.
